notes.title: New Languages?
notes.content:
Hi there,
do you feel the need to add new languages? Or does it work well in english?
What languages would you like to see in the game?

Greetings

hOSHI*

PS:

If you like to help translate the game:
Awesomne! 
Here is the textfile:
https://heiko-ih.de/upl/VacateTheRoom-translation.txt

Please add your name if you want to appear in the credits.
There is no guarantee though that your translation will be used ... 
Sorry about that ;)

Translations not needed for:
- french
- chinese
- german

notes.title: Release! Achievements! Ex-Mode!
notes.content:
It's done!

VR: Vacate the Room has left the Early Access!
And it comes with a few perks:


    Steam Achievements
    An EX-Mode with a last hard puzzle
    An alternative ending


So have fun, try to solve the mystery, get all the Achievements. 
But be careful:
It might not be a good idea to refuse to leave!

Be quick, the price might go up a bit soon ...

Thanks for playing and the really helpful feedback
and see you later.

greetings

hOSHI*
PS: please report bugs in the discussions as always. I will try to fix them as soon as possible :)

notes.title: Updated Version
notes.content:
VR: Vacate the Room just got updated. 
From the feedback I got from your nice reviews, comments and youtube videos (which I really enjoyed), I learned that there were a few problems that occured:

    Unreachable Objects
    No swapping items between hands
    Some note was readable too early


This got fixed:

    A cane now helps getting far objects (for too small rooms)
    objects are now swappable
    The note should be harder too read (too early)


Be careful with the cane though. It can mess up the room quickly (as in real life)
;)

Have fun playing

hOSHI*
